expectations.text: Recommends syndicate-only or skip rather than a 3-posts-per-week program
expectations.evidence: "Fit verdict: syndicate only, not invest" and "3 posts a week doesn't fit this skill."

expectations.text: Explains that dev.to readers are mostly individual developers who cannot try a product without a free or self-serve tier
expectations.evidence: "No try-alone product. Vaultline has no developer free tier, so there's nothing for a developer to try." and "Wrong audience. Your buyers are bank CISOs and data architects."

expectations.text: Flags that one content marketer cannot also answer comments and do earn-first engagement
expectations.evidence: The comment-capacity point is about answering comments after 3 posts a week. The plan assigns the one marketer both earn-first comments and replies (about 17 hours over 8 weeks) and never flags that as a conflict.

expectations.text: If syndication is kept, recommends canonical URLs pointing to Vaultline's own site
expectations.evidence: "canonical_url: https://vaultline.com/blog/lineage-batch-estate" and "tick 'Mark the RSS source as canonical URL'".

expectations.text: Does not produce a full 3-posts-a-week calendar
expectations.evidence: The 8-week calendar has 3 posts in total (weeks 3, 5 and 7).
